review_text_raw: This game exceeded my expectations! It was a little challenging at times (not being able to click a certain parts of the text  while in the notepad app and not being able to copy/pasting IP addresses) but was still a over all fun game. I didn't know what to expect in terms of characters and I was pleasently surprised at the diversity of the whole cast. Because the cast is so diverse, I could't predict who the final boss would be nor any of their accomplicies. I reccommend this game to people who like visual novels (a lot of reading for sure) and who like text-based mystery games. 10/10 from me! I hope to see more games from rebelephant soon!

the story really isn't engaging enough to justify the simple repetitive game mechanics, making it so [i]so[/i] tedious (i.e. [spoiler] take website url to find the ip and then hack the ip -> download everything -> read through everything -> rinse and repeat [/spoiler]). most damningly, there were a couple of bugs that froze my entire game--forcing me to restart the case from the beginning (since there are no manual saves).

at heart, i'm a completionist, but i don't think i'm gonna bother finishing this game.

A slightly abstract at times, hacking based puzzle game where you dig through computers to help solve crimes, and unravel a nice little story along the way.
Would recommend for anyone that enjoys puzzle games and a lot of reading.
